title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14955 West Bell Road in Surprise, Arizona, as the Marc Lee Memorial Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14955 West Bell Road in Surprise, Arizona, as the "Marc Lee Memorial Post Office Building."

summary.headline: This law names a US Postal Service building in Surprise, Arizona, the Marc Lee Memorial Post Office Building.
summary.what_it_does: It officially designates the Postal Service facility at 14955 West Bell Road in Surprise, Arizona, as the Marc Lee Memorial Post Office Building. The change is symbolic and honors Marc Lee. The summary does not describe any change to postal services, rules, or costs.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021.
